T2_historical_source_overlap_policy: Exclude target matches to all HDF positions and all sampled Legacy train/val/test astrometry. Downstream overlap audits read identity/positions only; deterministic raw-source reconstruction transiently reads all sampled roles before retaining train/val. No test photometry/labels are saved for training or evaluated.
group_rule: verified unique same TARGETID and <=1 arcsec map to Legacy imaging key; ambiguity removed; any historical test collision excluded; union validation wins
mixed_view_rule: One deterministic SHA256 chosen real view per galaxy; balanced survey sampling; never synthesize joint apertures
